nodes.description: Address of the contract administrator, set to msg.sender in constructor.
Public counter of total allocated founder amounts.
Public mapping(address => Founder) storing amountWithdrawn and totalAmountLocked per founder.
Immutable timelock start timestamp set to block.timestamp.
Immutable total amount available inside the timelock (50000000000000).
Running total of tokens withdrawn from the timelock.
Private mapping(uint256 => uint256) of vesting day to percentage available.
Constructor: sets start, admin and initializes vesting schedule.
Internal function that fills percentageAvailableByDays in 7-day steps up to 100%.
Admin-only function adding a founder with a locked amount.
receive() external payable, accepts plain ETH transfers.
Founder withdrawal function computing vested amount and performing ERC20 transfer.
View helper returning a founder's locked amount.
View helper returning the percentage for a normalized withdrawal day.
View helper returning amount available for msg.sender given a percentage.
View helper returning amount already withdrawn by msg.sender.
msg.sender, attacker-influenced caller identity used for auth and share lookups.
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time used for vesting and lock checks.
External call IERC20(token).transfer(owner, amount) executed before state updates, reentrancy prone.
Arithmetic on vested/withdrawn amounts (multiply, divide, subtract) determining payout size.
Parameter _founderAddress of addFounder: founder being registered.
Parameter _amountLocked of addFounder: amount to lock for the founder.
Parameter token of withdraw: ERC20 token address to transfer out.
Parameter _founder of checkFounderAllocation.
Parameter _daysElapsed of checkAvailability.
Parameter _percentAvailable of checkAmountAvailable.
Local address owner = msg.sender in withdraw, recipient of the transfer.
Local currentElapsedTime = block.timestamp - start in withdraw.
Local currentElapsedDays = currentElapsedTime / 86400 in withdraw.
Local normalized withdrawal day computed in withdraw.
Local percentage fetched from percentageAvailableByDays in withdraw.
Local vested amount = percentage * totalAmountLocked / 100 in withdraw.
Local claimable amount = vested minus already withdrawn in withdraw.
Local currentPercentage loop accumulator in _setWithdrawalSchedule.
Local startDay loop index in _setWithdrawalSchedule.
Local standardWithdrawalDay computed in checkAvailability.

edges.reason: Constructor calls the internal _setWithdrawalSchedule initializer.
Admin is assigned from untrusted msg.sender, granting privileged role to caller.
Immutable start time is derived from block.timestamp.
Constructor writes admin state variable.
Constructor writes the start timestamp.
_setWithdrawalSchedule populates percentageAvailableByDays mapping.
addFounder authorization check compares msg.sender against admin.
addFounder reads founders mapping for duplicate-address check.
addFounder enforces totalAllocated + _amountLocked <= totalAmountTimelocked.
addFounder reads and updates totalAllocated.
_founderAddress parameter indexes founders and zero-address check.
_amountLocked parameter is stored as founder locked amount.
addFounder increases totalAllocated state variable.
addFounder writes founder totalAmountLocked and amountWithdrawn.
withdraw uses msg.sender as the founder key for balance lookups.
withdraw reads founders[msg.sender] locked and withdrawn amounts.
withdraw computes elapsed time relative to start.
withdraw gating and vesting math depend on block.timestamp.
withdraw reads the percentage for the normalized vesting day.
withdraw checks withdrawn total against totalAmountTimelocked.
withdraw reads and updates totalAmountWithdrawn.
token parameter selects the ERC20 contract to transfer.
Local owner is the transfer recipient inside withdraw.
Local currentElapsedTime feeds day computation in withdraw.
Local currentElapsedDays feeds withdrawal-day normalization in withdraw.
Local standardWithdrawalDay indexes percentageAvailableByDays in withdraw.
Local percentageAvailableToOwner is used in the vested amount calculation.
Local amountAvailableToOwner is used in the claimable amount calculation.
Local amountAvailableForWithdrawal is the value transferred in withdraw.
withdraw performs the external ERC20 transfer call.
Untrusted token address determines which contract is called during transfer.
Claimable amount computed from callable data funds the external transfer.
totalAmountWithdrawn is updated only after the external call returns (state change after interaction).
founders[owner].amountWithdrawn is updated only after the external call returns.
withdraw computes vesting amounts via multiply, divide and subtract operations.
Vested amount local feeds the subtraction yielding the claimable amount.
Claimable amount local is the result of the subtraction arithmetic.
checkAmountAvailable reads founders[msg.sender].totalAmountLocked.
checkAmountWithdrawn reads founders[msg.sender].amountWithdrawn.
checkAmountAvailable reads the founders mapping.
checkAmountWithdrawn reads the founders mapping.
checkFounderAllocation reads founders[_founder].totalAmountLocked.
_founder parameter indexes the founders mapping.
_daysElapsed parameter drives the standard withdrawal day math.
Local standardWithdrawalDay indexes percentageAvailableByDays in the view helper.
checkAvailability reads percentageAvailableByDays.
_percentAvailable parameter is multiplied with the founder locked amount.
Local currentPercentage is the loop accumulator written into the mapping.
Local startDay is the loop index used as mapping key.

normalization_plan.reason: _founderAddress is only used inside addFounder to index the founders mapping.
_amountLocked is only used inside addFounder to set the founder allocation.
token selects the ERC20 target and flows into the external transfer inside withdraw.
_founder is only used as lookup key in the view helper.
_daysElapsed is only used to compute the withdrawal day in the view helper.
_percentAvailable is only used in the availability calculation of the view helper.
owner is the msg.sender-derived transfer recipient local of withdraw.
Intermediate elapsed-time local used only in withdraw.
Intermediate elapsed-days local used only in withdraw.
Normalized vesting-day local used only as mapping key in withdraw.
Percentage lookup local feeding the vested amount in withdraw.
Vested amount local is produced by the arithmetic operation in withdraw.
Claimable amount local is the value passed to the external ERC20 transfer in withdraw.
Loop accumulator local used only in the schedule initializer.
Loop index local used only in the schedule initializer.
Local day computation used only as mapping key in checkAvailability.
